reconstruction.scope: Holocaust History Museum, Yad Vashem: mapped long triangular concrete prism, narrow glazed ridge, recessed southeast side entrance and glazed end, western concave flared concrete wings, inset exit doors and open balcony, and the low circular Hall of Names roof light belonging to the same underground museum. The independent memorial hall, visitor centre, art/exhibition buildings, northern ranges, Children's Memorial, Pillar of Heroism and Cattle Car remain separate required collection members. Underground galleries/rooms and exhibition artwork are not reconstructed.

reconstruction.heightBasis: No height is supplied by the standard map. Working occupied floor794.2m absolute, concrete apex12.7m above floor and1.7m glazed ridge are picture-led estimates. Original coarse terrain rises over the buried central prism; no excavated corridor, broad slab or precinct flattening. West wing curvature, glazing/door inventory and Hall of Names roof position/radius/profile are reconstructions, not measurements.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Retain original Protomaps20261020 and unmodified Mapzen201x201/6m hill. Uncovered southeast approach provider internal[72,13], datum793.3169542466442m. No ground cutout: the museum is partly underground, so its original hillside must continue over buried lower faces. Only the named native building is replaced. Foundation below the occupied prism and a closed balcony retain contact where coarse grade falls. Exact entrances, thresholds/accessibility and underground terrain/interiors are unverified.
